title: Experimental Measurement of C2 Charging Time in Supercapacitor Equivalent Circuit
author: Luis Antonio Tenantitla Sanchez
materials: Usa un cable corto para minimizar inductancia.
Revisa polaridad de C2 una vez más.
Presiona DEFAULT en el osciloscopio para restablecer configuración.

steps.title: Prepare Protoboard Power Rails
steps.instruction: Reserve rows for the positive power supply and ground (GND) on the side rails of the protoboard, and label the ground rail as GND.

steps.title: Install Circuit Resistors
steps.instruction: Insert the resistors into the circuit according to the schematic topology.

substeps.instruction: Insert Rc (1 kΩ) between the positive source rail and the row that will serve as the circuit input node.
Place R1 (100 Ω) and R2 (100 Ω) as indicated by the schematic.

steps.title: Perform Electrical Continuity and Safety Checks
steps.instruction: With the power source turned off, verify the electrical integrity of the circuit.

substeps.instruction: Measure continuity between the GND rail and the negative terminal of C2 to ensure continuity exists.
Measure resistance between V+ and GND to confirm there is no direct short circuit.
Verify that the resistors show values approximately 100 Ω and 1 kΩ.

steps.title: Prepare Measurement Points
steps.instruction: Ensure the circuit is accessible for oscilloscope probing.

substeps.instruction: Leave the upper node of C2 free and accessible for the probe tip.
Ensure a connection point for the probe ground on the GND rail without creating loops.

steps.title: Initialize Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the power source and oscilloscope for operation.

substeps.instruction: Confirm the power source is off and set to 0 V.
Turn on the power source (set to 5 V) and the oscilloscope.

steps.title: Connect Capacitor
steps.instruction: Connect the positive and negative terminals of the voltage source to the capacitor C2, respecting the polarity.
